notes:
### 修复

- 截图用着用着按快捷键再也呼不出来、只能重启的问题：截图界面出了问题会自动重新建好，最多等几秒就能出来。
- 复制的内容偶尔没进记忆长廊：复制后剪贴板正被别的程序（比如远程控制软件的剪贴板同步）占着时，会稍等一下再读，不再直接漏掉；复制的图片也一样。

### 改进

- 图表绘制的绘图项目改成「先建任务、再定模板」：新建任务是一张空白模板，按提示贴样例数据、确认系列方向、定制系列和样式，以后每期只贴新数据。原来「把画好的图存成任务」改为临时绘图里的「存为任务」。
- 图表的系列方向一眼看得清：直接列出哪些是系列（图例）、哪些是横轴，不对就点「系列和横轴对调」；绘图任务里也能改。
- 图表类型新增「堆积柱」，一键把所有系列摞成一摞。

### Fixes

- The screenshot shortcut could stop working until restart: the screenshot screen now rebuilds itself when something goes wrong and comes up within a few seconds.
- Copied items occasionally missing from Memory Lane: when another app (such as a remote-control tool's clipboard sync) is holding the clipboard right after a copy, it now waits briefly and reads again instead of skipping it; copied images too.

### Improvements

- Chart projects now work "create the task first, then shape the template": a new task starts as a blank template; paste sample data, check the series direction and customize series and styles as prompted, then just paste new data each period. Saving a finished chart as a task is now "Save as task" in the scratch chart.
- The chart series direction is clear at a glance: it lists which items are series (legend) and which form the horizontal axis, with "Swap series and axis" if it is wrong; this also works inside chart tasks.
- New "Stacked bar" chart type stacks all series in one click.
